product_rsc.title: Retatrutide Peptide Vials (LY3437943)
product_rsc.description: Retatrutide, also called Reta or GLP-3 and identified by LY3437943, is a triple agonist: a GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptor agonist. It is supplied as lyophilized research material in single vials and 10-vial packs. Choose the size and Standard or Mannitol Free formulation. Match the received lot and formulation to its documentation. For laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.

acceptedAnswer.text: Retatrutide (LY3437943) is a synthetic 39-amino-acid peptide investigated for activity at GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors. Its parent-peptide identifiers are CAS 2381089-83-2, molecular formula C221H342N46O68 and molecular weight approximately 4,731 g/mol. These specifications exclude counterions and formulation additives. Materials are supplied for laboratory research and analytical use only.

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard (Default): 10mg, 12mg, 15mg, 20mg, 30mg, 50mg. Mannitol Free: 10mg, 15mg, 20mg, 30mg. mainEntity.name: How should lyophilized Retatrutide be stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Follow the storage instructions supplied with the material and the lot-specific documentation. Keep the container sealed and protected from light and moisture, and contact support if the appropriate storage conditions are unclear.

mainEntity.name: Where do orders ship from and how fast is delivery?

Orders with cleared payment before 2 PM Central on a business day normally ship that day; later orders normally ship the next business day, subject to order verification. Standard U.S. transit is typically 3–5 business days; expedited transit is typically 2–3. Orders of $99 or more qualify for free USPS Priority or FedEx 2Day shipping.
